about_the_game:
SCUM Deluxe edition includes a bundle of extra goods in your survival journey.

Basic survival pack

TEC-1 are not as heartless as everyone might think. With this pack, your prisoner will fly out of the plane and start their survival journey with a special improvised courier backpack containing a kitchen knife, a 0.5L water bottle, a can of sardines, an emergency bandage pack, and a whole bulb of garlic!

Three premium weapon models

Feeling that the M16, M1887, and the SVD could use some cosmetic flair? Look no further, as you’ll be able to craft the M16 Apocalypso, the Sawed-off Eagle, and the Deluxe SVD from the base models!

Two premium patterns

For those that want to express their inner woodland spirit, we’ve prepared the ‘Snake’ and ‘Trees’ patterns which you’ll be able to apply to both your vehicles and weapons.

Free gold card

Your one-time complimentary gold card is waiting for you at your nearest safezone general trader, which will enable you to purchase gold bars from the get-go!

Biome-specific colored prisoner suits

Orange does not suit everyone, especially if you want to blend into the natural environment of the island! Instead, you’ll be kicked out of the plane wearing colors that fit the biome you’ll parachute onto – brown for the Mediterranean biome, green for the forest biome, and white for the snow biome.

John/Jane Dick voice pack

Regular, non-DLC characters will be able to issue voice lines with the unforgettable voice of the legendary John and Jane Dick!

New exotic dances

If the area around you is a canvas, then dance moves are brushstrokes of the artist! Express your sensual side with 12 new exotic dance animations such as the ‘Belly dance,’ ‘Twerk,’ and ‘Vogue,’ to name a few.

Concept art collection

An assortment of various concept art from SCUM’s rich development history featuring different elements of the game.

content_descriptors.notes: The game allows nudity but has an option to turn it off. It features alcohol and some drugs.

short_description: Enhance your SCUM experience with the Digital Deluxe Edition! Express your inner survivor with a variety of cosmetics for your weapons, vehicles, and character, along with additional content to give you an edge in the fight to survive on the treacherous prison island.
supported_languages:
English*, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, French, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Thai, Polish
*languages with full audio support
